nom: KORRES Greek Yoghurt Probiotic Superdose Face Mask

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several say it calms and soothes with no irritation, while others report redness, burning, or new breakouts, particularly around the nose and mouth or with longer wear.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as rich and deeply moisturizing, including when used as an overnight treatment.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin mostly report a plumping, hydrating effect, though one found it left her skin dull with no noticeable glow.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin reports her pimples disappeared overnight after use.

concerns.redness: Several reviewers say the mask calmed existing redness or red patches, sometimes after a single use, but a few with sensitive skin report the mask itself caused redness or a burning sensation, especially when left on longer than the recommended 15 minutes.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report fewer breakouts or clearer skin with regular use, including for hormonal acne, though one reviewer with sensitive skin says it caused more acne for her.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry skin consistently describe it as rich and deeply moisturizing, though one reviewer hoping to repair a damaged moisture barrier found it soothing but less intensely hydrating than she had hoped.

aspects.libelle: Thick texture, takes effort to remove
Doesn't fully dry down on skin

extraits.texte: My skin is normally a combination. The product did leave my face moisturized after, but there was no after glow. My face looked pretty dull. I didn't feel as though this product was any different from an average face wash.

I really liked the packaging of this face mask. It was my first product from Korres and my first probiotic face mask. I liked the consistency of the mask, it was easy to apply evenly and easy to wash off. I did notice that it irritated my skin, but only around my nose and mouth area. This area became red, but I have very sensitive skin. The rest of my skin felt very hydrated after use. I would recommend doing a patch test first if you have sensitive skin.

I followed the pro tip and kept the mask in the fridge and I felt like it made it so much more soothing and relaxing. I liked the texture and how easy it was to apply and to wipe off. I just think it caused more acne on my sensitive skin.
Don't use even a few minutes more than 15 minutes of your skin will get hot and red. I'll be returning it irritated my skin 5 hours later still red:(

I have used this twice and wow. I have sever dry skin all over, this includes my face, and this actually moisturizes. I used this as a night cream the last two nights. (Did not wash off) A little goes a long way. My skin is soooo smooth and soft and actually moisturized when I wake up which is very hard for me to accomplish with other products I have tried. It also gives me a nice even tone. I am hoping with continued use I will see more benefits.10/10 recommended giving it a try, maybe even try using it as a night cream :)

I tried this product for the first time and it's great! Put it in the fridge and it provides a great sensation on your face as a facial. I've used this and my pimples disappeared overnight and/or seemed to be less inflamed or painful in the morning. I will definitely be using more products from Korres in the future. For reference, I am 22 and have acne-prone and oily skin.
